Subject: Virtual onsite availability — Senior Infrastructure Engineer

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for speaking with Morgan last week. We'd love to move forward with a virtual onsite (full loop) for the Senior Infrastructure Engineer role. The standard format at Redwood is a 3-block day split across two half-day sessions: deep system design + architecture panels, hands-on debugging/live exercise, and cross-functional leadership/culture panel with PM/EM.

Proposed windows (all times PDT):
- Option A — Day 1 (AM): Design panel (90m), Day 1 (PM): Debug exercise (60m)
- Option B — Day 2 (AM): Design panel (90m), Day 2 (PM): Cross-functional panel (60m)

We can run the whole loop in one long day if you prefer (8:30–4:30 with lunch), or split over two shorter half-days. Please reply with which option works best and any blackout times next week (Mon 8/9 — Fri 8/13).

Attached: your resume copy (for reference), the panel rubric we use, and the Zoom room IDs.

Best,
Irene
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
